verdict_metric_note: the verdict is read from the pre-registered cell. The fold-centred cell is reported beside it as a secondary, post-hoc reading: it removes the held-out fold's own per-gene mean from both sides, so it uses held-out outcomes and answers the narrower question of how well an arm separates one held-out perturbation from another. Arms are ordered by it because that is the harder question, not because the verdict rests on it

rule.redundant: the two tables are proxies for one underlying quantity reached by different routes: the concatenation does not beat the better of its two parts by more than the paired comparison resolves, and the parts' per-perturbation scores are correlated at Spearman 0.5 or above
rule.complementary: the two tables carry different information, which is a separate finding: the concatenation beats both parts with an interval clear of zero, and the parts' per-perturbation scores are correlated below Spearman 0.3
rule.mixed: anything else, reported as mixed rather than resolved either way

concat.reading_read_from: the grouped split in both cell lines; mixed unless they agree

protein.cell: full scope, grouped split, MLP translator

protein_transfer.unseen_gene_clearance_note: per destination-reference mode, how many (direction x arm) cells of the unseen-gene cross-line evaluation have a group-resampled interval clear of zero, out of 8 protein-derived (2 directions x 4 tables), 2 scGPT and 6 co-expression-or-null cells. The modes are not interchangeable: dest_reference scores half the destination's perturbations because the other half builds its reference
